dialogues.speaker: Andrevich
dialogues.text: Ready to go, my little treasure? This time, we can have a proper family trip to Morepesok. I heard there's a barbecue place there that's really good...

dialogues.speaker: Tsvetkov
dialogues.text: Yay! I want to ride a sleigh, too! They say that they have dogs that pull sleighs there.

dialogues.speaker: Uliana
dialogues.text: Of course, sweetheart. This time, we can finally take a few days to rest as a family...

dialogues.speaker: Tsvetkov
dialogues.text: Dad... You won't leave halfway through again because "something happened at the Energy Commission," will you?

dialogues.speaker: Andrevich
dialogues.text: No, last time it was... *sigh* Last time there were special circumstances. This time, I promise it won't happen again. All right?
